project_type: Static vanilla-JS prototype (src/public, no build step, all state in localStorage) + PostgreSQL schema/seed under database/ (no backend yet)
language: JavaScript (browser scripts sharing global scope), SQL (PostgreSQL)
build_system: None. Pages load core.js, data.js, store.js, portal.js then page scripts via <script> tags. No package.json in the repo and none may be added. Verification tools live outside the repo: PGlite + bcryptjs in %TEMP%\askdb (node_modules present); install playwright-core in %TEMP%\askpw (not installed yet).
test_framework: No unit tests. Verification = node .db-tmp/verify.mjs (PGlite harness, writes .db-tmp/verify.log) and new node .db-tmp/agree.mjs (prototype vs seed), plus headless Edge page loads with playwright-core.
verification_instructions: 1) node .db-tmp/verify.mjs must end with ALL CHECKS PASSED (db.sql then seed.sql zero errors, idempotent re-run, every table >=1 row, 0 FK orphans, date window except student_profile.dob and joined_on, grading vs examiner/HQ-room overlap, instructor double-booking across all dojos). 2) agree.mjs must print an empty mismatch list (or only allowlisted seed-only rows with reasons). 3) Serve src/public with a throwaway node http server on a free port, open all portal pages in headless Edge (playwright-core, executablePath C:\Program Files (x86)\Microsoft\Edge\Application\msedge.exe) at 1280px and 390px; no console errors, no 404s; screenshots to .db-tmp/screens/; stop the server.
snapshot_or_generated_files: verify.mjs regenerates .db-tmp/verify.log and .db-tmp/inventory.md. Nothing generated is checked in.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. NO git add/commit/push/reset/stash/checkout and no git config changes (work stays uncommitted on branch database-integration; earlier round work is uncommitted and must be kept). Edit files ONLY with the file edit tools, never shell redirection/Set-Content/sed. Do not touch .env, .env.example, .gitignore, app.js, prompts/. Do not create .agents/ or package.json/node_modules in the repo. psql is not installed. Prototype TODAY is the real clock; the seed anchor is 2026-11-06 (Fri), so agree.mjs must pin the clock (TZ=Asia/Singapore).
contribution_requirements: Date window for seed data: 2025-11-06..2027-11-06 except student_profile.dob and student_profile.joined_on. Keep SEED() shape in data.js. Keep data.js/store.js edits minimal and list every one in the final report. Online booking is HQ only. Grading is HQ only and never overlaps a lesson or an examiner's class.
key_patterns: data.js SEED() uses daysAgo(n)/addDays relative to TODAY; HQ session codes come from sessionCode(dojo, day, time, (4821 + i*137) % 9000 + 1000) over the index i of the sessions array; admin closureOn() in admin-shell.js reads DB.closures; store.js bumps DB_KEY when seed data shape changes (v3 comment) and has a one-time admSeed block adding 15 members via M(n, no, g, dojo, hrs, st, joinedAgo, extra); verify.mjs uses check(name, ok, detail) and rej() for negative tests.
directory_structure: database/ (db.sql, seed.sql, README.md); src/public/js (core, data, store, portal, ben); src/public/{student_portal,instructor_portal,admin_portal,landingpage}; .db-tmp/ scratch (plan2.md, verify.mjs, report.md, screens/, task-db-round2/ FEAT artifacts).
